title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Program Integrity Standard: Misreported-Earnings Reduction in a Waiting-Week Value
content:
For a waiting-week value on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the earnings disregard is reduced where the claimant's Benefit Overpayment Accounts show an overpayment caused by misreported earnings determined within the integrity window: the 12 months before the handling date, read by the overpayment's determination date. The amount read is each such overpayment's balance due.

| Overpayments of the claimant caused by misreported earnings, determined within the 12 months before the handling date | Reduction of the disregard |
|---|---|
| Any of them still carries a balance due above zero | 60.00 (the open integrity amount) |
| Such overpayments exist and every one carries no balance due | 40.00 (the repaid integrity amount) |
| None was determined within that window | None |

The integrity reduction is taken from the disregard before the earnings above it are measured, and the reduced disregard is never below zero.

### Hypothetical cases (disregard of 103.80 before reduction)

| Overpayment record | Disregard used |
|---|---|
| One determined 5 months ago, balance due 120.00 | 43.80 |
| One determined 5 months ago, balance due 0.00 | 63.80 |
| One determined 14 months ago, balance due 120.00 | 103.80 |
| One caused by unreported other pay, determined 2 months ago | 103.80 |
